description: Weline 缓存绕过：客户端显式声明 X-Weline-Cache-Bypass=1 时直接回源

expression: http.request.headers["x-weline-idempotent"][0] eq "1" and (http.request.method eq "GET" or http.request.method eq "HEAD")
description: Weline 幂等请求：客户端声明 X-Weline-Idempotent=1 的 GET/HEAD 请求允许 CDN 短期缓存（10 分钟）

expression: (http.request.method eq "GET" or http.request.method eq "HEAD") and not http.request.uri.path matches "^/admin/" and not http.request.uri.path matches "^/backend/" and not http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/"
description: 店面 GET/HEAD：仅当源站带 Cache-Control/CDN-Cache-Control 时进入 CF 边缘（配合 FPC HIT 出站 CDN-Cache-Control）；无缓存头则 bypass，避免把 SSR MISS 冻进边缘
